label: Case reference
type_unit: id (CASE-REF-nnnn)
notes: The handle the customer quotes to support; shown on every surface

label: Policyholder name
type_unit: text
notes: Field shows it with the shop; referral agents see the customer name with stage and sub-status only (FLD-008)

label: Case sub-status
type_unit: enum: open | on hold | rework | declined | cancelled | lapsed
notes: Production vocabulary (D-001). Harbor renders it in plain words. Never declined on a provider failure

label: Risk tier
type_unit: enum: 1 | 2 | 3
notes: Engine output. Shown to staff and never to the customer (policies/risk-tiers-and-routing.md)

label: Queue clock against the service level
type_unit: hours elapsed of the commitment (24 h verification; 12 h rework re-check; example)
current_storage: derived — h_verification.queued_at and h_rework_item.resubmitted_at against the configured service level
notes: Harbor shows the customer wording only (within one working day). Pause and stop rules are policy (policies/service-levels.md); whether production pauses the clock is not established

label: Manual verification method
type_unit: enum: document inspection | video call | field visit
notes: Regulated evidence: manual method where used (regulated-actions.md). h_audit_event.metadata cannot hold it while it is empty (context/05 trap 2)

label: Checklist item
type_unit: enum from the checklist for product and shop type
notes: Items and conditions: policies/document-checklist.md

label: Document status
type_unit: enum: received | accepted | unreadable | mismatched | missing
notes: received is set on upload (HUB-007); the rest by the officer (context/04)

label: Document reference
type_unit: id (DOC-REF-nnnn) with version
notes: A replacement is a new version of the same reference; the rework item points at it

label: Capture tip for the item
type_unit: text per checklist item
current_storage: config — the Field slot text (what the officer needs to see; FLD-002)
notes: Exists for Field slots. The feature shows the same text on Harbor rework items and in the Desk reason picker

label: Why the insurer needs the item
type_unit: text per checklist item
current_storage: config — document checklist column (why the insurer needs it)
notes: Shown in full before the first upload (HUB-004); repeated on a missing item

label: Reason code
type_unit: enum: unreadable | mismatched | missing
notes: Required on return (DESK-004). A verifier may mark inspection items rework (FLD-006)

label: Field that differs on a mismatched item
type_unit: enum of case-record fields: policyholder name | shop address | date of birth
notes: The gap named in HUB-008 and DESK-004. Items raised before the feature have no value: show MISSING and never a blank

label: What the record says for the differing field
type_unit: text (the case value)
current_storage: derived — the h_case or h_customer column named by RWK-02
notes: Lets the customer fix the document or the record once

label: Rule that fired
type_unit: configured rule name and the input that triggered it
notes: Exists on the case view (DESK-003). The feature names it on the rework item and in plain words to the customer

label: Customer-facing reason text
type_unit: text in the customer language (h_customer.language)
current_storage: config — message template per reason code and language
notes: Templates exist per stage and language (context/03). The feature adds the field that differs and the rule in plain words. Asks nothing new without consent (regulated-actions.md)

label: Next step for the customer
type_unit: enum: re-upload on Harbor | field verifier captures on site | correct the case detail
notes: Exists (HUB-008). Which reasons route to the field verifier is D-006 PENDING

label: Days left before the case goes on hold
type_unit: days remaining of the window (7 days; D-004 PENDING)
current_storage: derived — h_rework_item.raised_at plus the configured window
notes: Keeps running on a provider failure; only the verification clock pauses (service-levels policy

label: Open rework items on the case
type_unit: count
current_storage: derived — h_rework_item rows per case where resubmitted_at is null
notes: The Field route shows it (FLD-001). The Desk queue does not (gap in desk/current-behaviour.md); the feature adds it

label: Replacement capture status
type_unit: enum: not started | pending send | replacement sent | attached
notes: FLD-004 pending send; FLD-005 replacement sent; DESK-006 attached

label: Resolvable on site by the field verifier
type_unit: yes | no per reason code
notes: Recommendation: unreadable and missing yes; mismatched no (D-006 PENDING)

label: Identity-check provider result
type_unit: enum: verified | not matched | provider-failed
notes: Timeout 90 s (example). provider-failed never declines; the case goes to the retry queue (context/04)

label: Retry attempts against the limit
type_unit: count of attempts and the configured limit
notes: The retry limit is open under D-007 (two automatic retries recommended); where attempts are stored has no current path

label: Regulated action
type_unit: enum: identity verification | consent and disclosure | record retention | cooling-off | claim acknowledgement | complaint handling
notes: One row per action on the case (DESK-009)

label: Actor role
type_unit: enum of roles
notes: Roles and never names

label: Event time
type_unit: timestamp
notes: Shown beside the actor role (DESK-009)

label: Evidence reference
type_unit: id: provider response reference | document reference | consent text version
notes: Links to the evidence record (DESK-009). The provider response reference is the evidence for identity verification

label: Consent record
type_unit: consent text version; time; channel; language
current_storage: h_audit_event rows with action consent: evidence_ref and occurred_at; channel and language were in metadata
notes: metadata has been empty since the August release (context/05 trap 2) so channel and language evidence has no current path. Owner: compliance officer

label: Delete-after date
type_unit: date
current_storage: derived — h_policy.end_at plus 7 years; unissued cases: last customer action plus 2 years (example)
notes: Record retention evidence (regulated-actions.md). Backfilled for cases that exist before the feature lands

label: Identity number
type_unit: text; last 4 characters outside the verification screen
notes: Full value on the Desk verification screen only. Each view of a masked value is an audit event (policies/data-handling-and-retention.md)
